data_gaps: Only successfully ingested event source windows are represented; unobserved hours and months are not zero activity.
PushEvent payload commit objects omit commit history outside the observed public event stream.
Repository language data excludes repositories with empty or unavailable GitHub language measurements from language-share denominators.
No source failure has been recorded in the current state.

biases: time-of-day sampling bias for scheduled event collection
limitations.gharchive: GH Archive is an observed public event stream. PushEvent payload commit objects are not a complete commit census and are not equivalent to pushes.
limitations.github_search_api: GitHub Search API has a 1,000-result cap and rate limits; it cannot establish an authoritative global repository census.
limitations.historical_data: Public historical datasets and API metadata are bounded or stale populations, not a complete history.

observed_event_stream.coverage: observed source windows only; scoped to the recorded repository filter; not a complete commit census

selection_frame.description: A small, deterministic public repository panel. It is not a representative sample or GitHub-wide census.

reporting_language: Declared attribution is evidence of an explicit declaration under the named rule version; it is not proof of code origin.
